bounded_continuation_allowed: backend upgrade preflight for logits/hidden states/attention

field_principles.attention_available: whether attention tensors are available from the current local runtime path.
field_principles.carry_token_energy_continue: boolean continuation recommendation for the arithmetic carry lane.
field_principles.completion_split_available: whether prompt/completion token separation is available.
field_principles.forbidden_claims: list of claims not supported by the available features.
field_principles.future_signal_allowed: boolean; false if only tautological/text-only evidence exists.
field_principles.hidden_states_available: whether hidden states are available from the current local runtime path.
field_principles.logits_available: whether logits are available from the current local runtime path.
field_principles.methodology_min_duration_s: minimum duration required for any future live signal claim.
field_principles.retire_recommendation: boolean indicating whether the lane should be retired until new backend features exist.
field_principles.status: complete only if the precondition gate is written from actual artifact/runtime evidence.
field_principles.tests_run: list of commands run or no-code-change explanation.
field_principles.token_feature_gate_ready: true only if feature availability and no-go decisions are explicit.
field_principles.tokenprob_rows_available: whether reliable per-token logprob rows are available.
field_principles.unsafe_false_accepts: count of invalid energy claims accepted by this gate; should be zero.

forbidden_claims: new token/internal-energy signal from text-only or top-logprob rows
carry-token energy margin or carry-token separability signal
broad hallucination detection, reasoning verification, or answer-quality claim
FLaG-style latent/internal evidence claim without hidden states or attention
HalluField or thermodynamic token-path stability claim without logits
attention-energy or grounding claim without attention tensors
hidden-state basin, residual-stream, or latent-probe claim without hidden states
promotion of tokenprob feature receipts into internal-energy readiness
honest_verdict: complete: retire carry-token energy lane until logits/hidden states/attention and feature-complete non-tautological controls exist

minimum_preconditions.name: live_methodology_duration
minimum_preconditions.requirement: methodology_duration_s >= 60.0 and not copied from duration_s

minimum_preconditions.name: runtime_provenance
minimum_preconditions.requirement: current local model/backend path, selected model spec, and MODEL_SPECS provenance

minimum_preconditions.name: claim_matching_internal_surface
minimum_preconditions.requirement: logits for logit/thermodynamic claims; hidden states for latent claims; attention for attention claims

minimum_preconditions.name: token_localization
minimum_preconditions.requirement: prompt/completion token split plus token timing for token-local claims

minimum_preconditions.name: positive_controls
minimum_preconditions.requirement: feature-complete non-tautological positive controls with known targets

minimum_preconditions.name: negative_controls
minimum_preconditions.requirement: feature-complete perturbed and no-signal controls with positive margins

minimum_preconditions.name: safety
minimum_preconditions.requirement: unsafe_false_accepts == 0 and retired external-scorer scope remains closed
